#345 · Sea Lily Pokémon

Lileep

Rock Grass

Hoenn · Generation 3

Lileep is a Rock/Grass-type Sea Lily Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 23.8 kg. It evolves into Cradily. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (87), with a base stat total of 355.
